questions.old_question: Which hosted adapter can supply independent host usage and ZFS samples without changing the production Collector's freshness semantics?
questions.answer: Native zfs-check observe/headroom and fleet reservation/report probes exist. A hosted TCG adapter with correlated independent sample at admission commit is not built.
questions.proposed_catalog_edit: Tag partial; retain native versus hosted evidence distinction and specify timestamped read-only probes.

questions.old_question: Can a fault hold the real pool mutation lock long enough to exercise busy samples?
questions.answer: Pool.report takes a zero-wait .lilly-storage lock; contention maps to busy:true and Marshall preserves the prior pool timestamp. Native usage-moving busy is tested, but no held-lock admission scenario was found.
questions.proposed_catalog_edit: Tag partial; require actual lock hold across Collector cycle and before/after freshness admission probe.
